else.reason: Company Name is not the current name unless Current Name Indicator is Y

then.reason: Current Name is supplied only when Current Name Indicator is null
ACN field holds an ARBN when Type is RACN

field_mappings.semantic_evidence: Company name as it appears on the register
field_mappings.transformation: Use Company Name as the registered legal name only when Current Name Indicator equals Y, which the help file defines as the flag for the current company name. Apply whitespace trimming only. Rows with a null indicator are handled by the Current Name mapping.

When Current Name Indicator is null, use Current Name as the current legal name, per the documented IF Current Name Indicator is null THEN show current company name rule. When the indicator is present (Y), omit this branch. Apply whitespace trimming only.
When Type equals RACN, omit because the ACN field holds an ARBN. Otherwise parse the ACN field as a whole 9-digit ACN without requiring a label and validate its checksum.

When ABN equals the documented placeholder 0, omit it because the source shows 0 when the company has no ABN. Otherwise parse the ABN as an 11-digit ABN without requiring a label and validate its checksum.

Map only the documented code DRGD (De-registered) to deregistered. Other codes, including REGD, are left unmapped (null) because no same-field meaning explicitly establishes a canonical equivalent for them.

field_mappings.semantic_evidence: Date on which a company was registered
field_mappings.transformation: Parse the value as a date using the documented DD/MM/YYYY format. Do not infer a timezone.
